name: UV Protection Sunglasses
description: Stylish UV400 protection sunglasses with polarized lenses, perfect for beach days and summer outings. Lightweight frame with anti-glare coating.

name: SPF 50+ Sunscreen Lotion
description: Broad-spectrum SPF 50+ sunscreen lotion that protects against UVA & UVB rays. Water-resistant, non-greasy formula suitable for all skin types.

name: Straw Beach Hat
description: Handwoven wide-brim straw hat that provides natural shade and sun protection. Adjustable inner band fits all head sizes. Perfect poolside and beach accessory.

name: Women's Floral Bikini Set
description: Vibrant floral print bikini set with adjustable straps and tie sides. Made from chlorine-resistant fabric for long-lasting color. Available in S, M, L, XL.

name: Men's Quick-Dry Swim Shorts
description: Lightweight quick-dry swim shorts with mesh lining and side pockets. Built-in UV protection UPF 50+. Elastic waistband with drawstring for a secure fit.

name: Leather Strap Flat Sandals
description: Genuine leather flat sandals with cushioned footbed and adjustable ankle strap. Slip-resistant rubber sole ideal for beach boardwalks and city strolls.

name: Men's Linen Short-Sleeve Shirt
description: 100% pure linen short-sleeve shirt in breathable, lightweight fabric. Relaxed fit perfect for summer vacations, beach bars, and casual outings. Available in 6 colors.

name: Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle
description: Double-wall vacuum insulated bottle keeps drinks cold for 24 hours. BPA-free, leak-proof lid with carry loop. Perfect for hot summer days and outdoor activities.

name: Oversized Beach Tote Bag
description: Spacious canvas tote bag with inner zipper pocket and mesh side pockets. Fits towels, sunscreen, snacks, and more. Machine washable and water-resistant lining.

name: Quick-Dry Microfiber Beach Towel
description: Ultra-absorbent microfiber beach towel that dries 3x faster than cotton. Sand-free, compact, and foldable. Comes with a carrying pouch. Size: 150 x 75 cm.

name: Portable Beach Umbrella
description: Compact 6.5 ft windproof beach umbrella with UPF 50+ canopy. Lightweight aluminum pole with sand anchor. Sets up in under 60 seconds. Includes carry bag.

name: Aloe Vera After-Sun Gel
description: Pure aloe vera cooling gel with vitamin E for soothing sunburned and irritated skin. Fragrance-free, alcohol-free formula. Fast-absorbing, non-sticky finish.

name: Women's Flowy Sundress
description: Lightweight flowy sundress in breathable rayon fabric with a tropical print. Spaghetti straps, smocked bodice, and tiered hem. Perfect for beach and brunch.

name: Waterproof Bluetooth Speaker
description: IPX7 waterproof portable Bluetooth speaker with 360° surround sound. 12-hour battery life, floats on water, includes carabiner clip. Perfect for beach and pool parties.

name: Reef-Safe Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30
description: 100% mineral reef-safe sunscreen with zinc oxide. Sheer, non-whitening formula. Ideal for sensitive skin and ocean swimming. Certified cruelty-free and vegan.

name: Foldable Portable Beach Chair
description: Lightweight aluminum foldable beach chair with adjustable backrest and cup holder. Supports up to 300 lbs. Includes carry strap and matching storage bag.

name: Men's Casual Linen Shorts
description: 100% linen casual shorts with elastic waistband and two side pockets. Breathable and moisture-wicking. Available in khaki, navy, white, and olive. Regular and relaxed fit.

name: Polarized Sports Sunglasses
description: High-performance polarized sunglasses with TR90 flexible frame. 100% UV400 protection, anti-scratch lens coating. Ideal for cycling, running, fishing, and beach activities.
